content.thinking: Bug in fuzzer: npart up to 32 but n could be < 32 after computing n from links... Actually n = max(...)+1 could be small if links happen to only involve low vertices. Fix: npart = rng.randint(2, min(32, n)).

arguments.command: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/    npart = rng.randint(2, 32)/    npart = rng.randint(2, min(32, n))/' tmp/tests/fuzz_huge.py && timeout 1800 python3 tmp/tests/fuzz_huge.py 61 30 && timeout 1800 python3 tmp/tests/fuzz_huge.py 62 15 tight
